summary.text: Justin Fornstrom is a Republican state representative from Wyoming who has represented House District 10 since December 2025 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026.
A farmer and business owner, he has served as mayor of Pine Bluffs.

paragraphs.text: Justin Fornstrom was born in Falls Church, Virginia, and earned a bachelor's degree in health sciences from the University of Wyoming.
His career experience includes working as a farmer and a business owner, and he has served as president of Laramie County Fire District 5 and as mayor of Pine Bluffs, Wyoming.
Fornstrom was appointed to House District 10 on December 6, 2025, succeeding John Eklund Jr., and took office on December 16, 2025.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 18, 2026.
